title: Mission log, version 1
description: JSON Lines: one header, then one record per control tick. It holds what the robot's software receives, so software/stockcar/replay.py can rerun the estimator and supervisor from it. The simulator writes it today; the robot should write the same fields once its sensors are chosen.

start_pose.description: x in, y in, heading rad on the organizer CAD field

enc.description: left, right encoder counts since the previous tick

white.description: reflectance sensors seeing white, in array order

changes.description: reflectance sensors that changed this tick

tof.description: range readings in inches, null for no return

obs.description: observations given to the supervisor this tick

state.description: supervisor state the robot reached, if logged

pose.description: the robot's own estimate, if logged
